name: California
metaDescription: Event setup and cleanup plus housekeeping in the Sacramento region of California. See the cities Service With A Smile serves and call (916) 866-2270.
overview: Service With A Smile works in the Sacramento region, the part of California we know best. Linda is based in Oak Park, and every job is planned and run by her personally, so we stay close to home rather than try to cover the whole state.

Event work around Sacramento follows the calendar. Spring and fall are the busiest months for weddings and quinceañeras. Summer brings backyard parties and reunions, often in 100-degree heat, which changes how food, trash and setup have to be handled. The holidays fill church halls and family homes.

beforeYouHire.p: Setup only, cleanup only, or both? Dishes, trash removal, restrooms, table and chair breakdown? Get it in writing before the day.
Many halls and churches set a hard exit time and their own cleaning checklist. Share it with whoever you hire so nothing is missed and your deposit comes back.
Ask who will actually be doing the work on the day. With us, Linda plans the job and is there for it.

regionNote: We are growing one city at a time and only add a city once we can serve it well. If your town isn't listed yet, call and ask. Linda will tell you honestly whether she can help.
